$comment: #EXP-1617 / #EXP-1804 THE CI RUNNER SECTION of a device's detail (view `machine-settings`, ×4), genUI catalog only. DATA: the device row (devices shape: `runner` = {enabled, labels, slots, timeoutMin} or null = never set up, `caps`, `platform`, `user_id`) and the `ci_jobs` rows it ran (`runner_device_id`, synced). WRITE: one `ci.setRunner{deviceId, enabled, labels, slots, timeoutMin}` per change (the whole settings object; `defaults` fill a null `runner`), the device OWNER only. LAYOUT inside a `Section` titled copy.section: first the `notice` as an `Alert` when it is not null; then a `SettingsRow` (label copy.enabled.label, description copy.enabled.description) holding a `Switch`; then, only while enabled, a `ChipInput` (label copy.labels.label, placeholder copy.labels.placeholder, max limits.labels; every entry through `normalizeLabel`, a null result is refused inline with copy.labels.invalid, a duplicate is dropped), a `NumberField` (label copy.slots, min limits.slots.min, max limits.slots.max, step 1) and a `Select` (label copy.timeout, options = `timeoutOptions`, value = String(timeoutMin)); the platform's OS label (`osLabel`) shows as the ChipInput's first suggestion; then copy.recent as a `Heading` level 4 and `recentJobs` as `Row`s (icon = pr-checks glyph, title = check, subtitle = copy.runSubtitle with {number} and {repo}, meta = duration), copy.noJobs as a muted `Text` when there are none. Every control is `disabled` for a viewer who is not the owner (a teammate's shared device). RULES: `normalizeLabel` trims and lowercases, then must match eCode's label rule `^[a-z0-9][a-z0-9._-]{0,31}$`; `notice` (one, in this order): a PHONE client (iOS, Android, web-mobile) gets copy.notice.phone (info: phones set a runner up, they never run jobs), a device without the `ci-runner` cap gets copy.notice.update (warning: its app is too old to run jobs), else null; `osLabel` maps the device platform: linux → linux, macos|darwin → mac, windows → windows, else null; `recentJobs` = the jobs with this runner, newest `startedAt` first (never started last), at most limits.recent.

enabled.label: Run CI jobs
enabled.description: Runs your team's pipelines on this device.

labels.label: Labels
labels.invalid: Use lowercase letters, digits, dots, dashes or underscores.

phone.title: Set up here, runs on the device
phone.message: A phone never runs CI jobs: this sets up the device's runner.

update.title: Update this device
update.message: Its app is too old to run CI jobs.

recentJobs.name: this runner's newest first, at most five
